analytical_satellite_integration.auth_pattern: Standard Bearer JWT via Authorization header from localStorage ('jwt_token')
analytical_satellite_integration.separation_of_concerns: Strict separation between visual satellite basemap tiles (visual inspection/context) and analytical backend satellite land-cover evidence (quantified categorical surface evidence and risk contribution points).

frontend_components_changed.description: Exposes authenticated API client for GET /api/satellite/land-cover with AbortSignal cancellation support.

Added compact Satellite Evidence card rendering source, land-cover class, category, risk context, and contribution points when available; renders strict 'Satellite evidence unavailable' state when missing/errored.
Configured BASEMAPS with OpenStreetMap Standard and Esri World Imagery; exposed toggle button in header and wired active basemap to MapFloatingControls and TileLayer.
Connected layer toggle button with dynamic active state highlighting and accessible descriptive tooltips.
Added active state glow and styling for active satellite basemap button.
Updated layer button toggle tests and added satellite basemap switching test ensuring markers and overlays remain intact.
Added comprehensive test suite covering available, unavailable, unknown, loading, and error states for Satellite Evidence.

display_fields: Land-cover class (e.g. Bare Ground / Tree Cover)
Normalized category (bare / vegetation / cropland / built_up / water)
Contextual risk interpretation (e.g. Increased surface vulnerability)

safety_constraints: Never displays 0 as a fake value
Never displays fabricated class or category

error_and_timeout_state.behavior: Safely isolated in Promise catch block; falls back to 'Satellite evidence unavailable' without breaking primary environmental intelligence or map controls.

features_verified: Switching to satellite basemap preserves CircleMarkers, popups, and HUD overlays
CartoDB Voyager is never exposed or requested
Satellite evidence card renders available data (source, class, category, context, contribution)
Vegetative satellite evidence renders stabilizing context and negative contribution
Unknown category renders 'Satellite evidence unavailable' without fake values
Loading state displays 'Querying satellite observations...' non-blockingly
API network error / rate-limit gracefully handled

backend_status.backend_integrity: 100% unaffected. All backend services and models remain identical to Step 54C.

known_limitations: Esri World Imagery tile service is a public global basemap without cloud-mask guarantees on specific historical dates.
Analytical Sentinel-2 10m land cover represents optical observation; during heavy monsoon cloud-cover events, classification falls back safely to 'Satellite evidence unavailable'.
SAR interferometry (Sentinel-1 ground displacement) and real-time NDVI changes are excluded from this step per scope constraints.
